Build an AI assistant around approved business information, useful tasks and clear boundaries, so more enquiries have a helpful next step, including outside your team’s working hours.

An illustration, not a live agent. The final assistant is configured and tested for your business.

A useful role in everyday business

More than a greeting.
A practical next step.

Choose the jobs that fit your process. Keep important decisions and commitments with the people responsible for them.

Answer customer questions

Use approved business knowledge to respond to routine questions about your services, process and other agreed information. Define when a person should take over.

Screen and qualify enquiries

Collect relevant information and apply your agreed qualification criteria so the team has useful context. This supports human decisions; it is not unrestricted authority to accept or reject people.

Help arrange appointments

Use configured calendars and booking rules where supported. Confirm availability, services and what the assistant may change.

Share approved information

Use supported rich-message features to share approved files, or configured workflows to send emails and attachments. Availability depends on the channel and setup.

Activate agreed tasks

Trigger configured workflows, notifications or follow-up tasks within defined permissions. The assistant can support several functions without being authorised to do anything it chooses.

Keep the conversation moving after hours

Configured AI can handle routine enquiries when your team is away and preserve context for follow-up. Availability depends on services and setup; no missed-lead, uptime or response guarantee is implied.

Business knowledge, maintained

Consistent information.
Connected experiences.

Approved knowledge sources can be attached to chat and voice agents. Channel and agent configuration still matter: a shared source does not automatically activate every channel or make every action available everywhere.

Review conversations, identify unanswered questions and update the knowledge base. The improvement loop is deliberate and supervised, not a claim that the assistant teaches itself from every interaction.

An illustrative after-hours enquiry

A question tonight.
Context for the team tomorrow.

Someone asks Elena’s events business about an occasion while her team is away. A configured assistant can answer approved questions, collect relevant details and route the conversation for the team’s next step.

Human handoff can assign and notify the team and pause the bot. It does not promise that a person is immediately available.

Capability scope and setup boundaries

Product capability does not establish what is included or activated in your AyudaGrow engagement. We agree the supported channels, permissions and tasks for your business.

AI usage, channel charges and additional features may apply. Confirm operating limits, support arrangements and a fallback plan before activation.
